name: Cipher Toolkit
description: A growing collection of classic and modern cipher implementations — Caesar, Vigenère, substitution and XOR — with encode, decode and brute-force helpers. Part of the Bugfish crypto experiments; the same shift cipher that guards the vault in the terminal game on the home page.

name: Hash Cracker
description: A fast and flexible Windows tool for encoding and brute-forcing password hashes across multiple algorithms.
